title: Incompressible planar surfaces in hyperbolic link exteriors in the 3-sphere
summary: For each integer $N\geq 3$ we construct examples of $N$-component hyperbolic links $L\subset\mathbb{S}^3$ whose exterior contains an incompressible spanning planar surface $P\subset X_L$ with one boundary component on each boundary torus of $X_L$ of nonmeridional and nonintegral slope, thus providing counterexamples to a recent conjecture of M. Eudave-Muñoz and M. Ozawa. The case $N=3$ is the crucial one to consider: all such link pairs $(L,P)$ are classified and found to be generated by the structure of the exterior of hyperbolic Eudave-Muñoz knots.
